title: Analyzing Hidden Motivations
grammar: Inflected reflexive pronouns (magát, magában, magával, magába) vs. verbal suffixes
goal: I can use inflected forms of the reflexive pronoun maga/önmaga across psychological idioms
I can contrast suffixal middle verbs (megnyugszik) with explicit reflexive pronoun constructions (megnyugtatja magát, magába zárkózik)
I can express self-awareness, self-deception, and inner reconciliation in B2 Hungarian
